about:
US Med-Equip is headquartered in Charleston, West Virginia. The company operates as a national provider of medical equipment rentals, sales, and biomedical services to hospitals and health systems.

The company maintains a fleet of over 160,000 pieces of equipment across more than 100 locations nationwide. Its services include movable medical equipment rentals and sales, beds and therapeutic surfaces, biomedical preventive maintenance and repair, asset management, system shutdown support, and telemetry monitoring. Manufacturer-certified biomedical technicians service all equipment, and the company offers free delivery on rentals with a target of two hours plus drive time.

US Med-Equip serves hospitals and health systems across the United States. Customer testimonials reference partnerships with North Memorial Health, Select Specialty Hospitals, CHI San Franciscan Rehabilitation Hospital, Sentara Princess Anne Hospital, Malbis Freestanding Emergency Department, Dignity Health, Prisma Health, Cook Children's Medical Center, Encompass Health, Hackensack Meridian Health, and Atrium Health.

The company's stated mission is to promote the healing process by providing smart solutions for healthcare partners and patients. It differentiates itself through its GoUSME Connect™ technology platform, which enables clinicians to secure equipment on demand, and a service model that treats every order as if it were for a family member.
